title: How to clean a phone

pieces.say: Your phone is dirtier than your toilet.
pieces.text: Your phone is dirtier than your toilet.
pieces.label: GROSS ALERT

pieces.say: It goes everywhere. Clean it weekly.
Switch off, take the case off.
Wipe it with an alcohol wipe.
Wash the case in soapy water.
No sprays, no bleach, never mix cleaners.
pieces.text: No sprays or bleach. Never mix cleaners.

pieces.say: Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
